rows.evidence: Q1: Abstract - a causal loop diagram was formulated from literature review and the authors' own qualitative interviews with 60 coffee farmers and experts in Dak Lak Province, so the study reports its own (qualitative) data.
rows.notes: Extended abstract only (MODSIM 2019). The study is a qualitative system-dynamics diagnosis of drought impacts on coffee in Dak Lak: it identifies declining dry-season rainfall, coffee expansion and over-irrigation (especially groundwater) as drivers, and names systems archetypes. Drip or sensor-based irrigation is never tested or evaluated; 'promotion of technologies and policy measures on efficient water use for irrigation' appears only in a list of proposed management strategies. No result of its own on drip irrigation delivering drought resilience or risk management. The quantitative simulation model is stated as in progress, with no runs or validation reported.

notes: Document is an extended abstract (one page) without methods detail, results tables or figures; the causal loop diagram itself is described but not shown. Rated on what the abstract reports.
